report.summary: The total sentiment share change between the baseline and window was a fall of 0.24 percentage points, sitting well within normal variation bounds. Stability and bug complaints rose by 8.36 percentage points in negative reviews during the window compared to the baseline. The estimated patch effect on positive share at 14 days was 0.9 points, with a p-value for the synthetic control estimate at the 14 day horizon of 0.36. There were 0 sale days during the evaluation window. Off-topic negative mentions remained at 0 percent during the window, and the compositional effect on the positive share change was a fall of 0.24 points. H5 is supported. H2, H3, and H4 are ruled out. H1 is inconclusive.
